timeline.tweet: I have such an amazing job. I am struggling to keep up at the moment so they are allowing me to up my marketing hours and lower my bar hours. #MultipleSclerosis #inverness #support #lovemyjob #MS #DisabilityConfident
How many notes are too many notes when you think you'll forget everything? #NewJob #MS #makingMSwearable #brainfog

Loving my new job. Found another amazing boss who has safety nets in place if I'm struggling. Had a day working from home yesterday. Here is a taster of what I'm up to. #multiplesclerosis #MS #Marketing #LoveMyJob
I have been really lucky with understanding employers. We are moving to Canada in 5months time. A bit nervous they won't be as understanding as the Scottish

AHH! Life is so busy. In 3 1/2 months I get married, 4 months I move to Canada, anyday soon I'll get a neurologist appointment for hopefully answers and a plan and just helped open a new store at work. #multiplesclerosis #bridetobe #ChilloutTime
Happy Canada 🇨🇦 Day you lovely Canadians out there. So excited to move over in 4 months #CanadaDay #CanadaDay2019
Goodbye Highlands! Back to Angus!! Really excited to go back to the central belt and beaches! Hopefully it will be warmer too.
I'm in Scotland. They have done a load of tests up here and it's just an appointment to discuss what has been found. I'm heading to Canada for a year so will just get my appointment when I come back

PRIDE MARCH IN #Inverness today. You all look amazing! Enjoy your afternoon of parties. So proud of my shop to let us sell the flags when it is owned by a strongly Muslim family. #proudness #pride #loveislove
Just reduced my hours at work from 40-50 hours a week to 35-40. I feel like I've let the team down but also excited about feeling less broken. #ms #MultipleSclerosis #mschat
Ahhh getting so stressed with wedding planning right now.
That sounds awesome. I live in Inverness which up in the Highlands. There is a group in Ross-shire which is a bit if a drive away. I'm moving to Canada soon so hopefully more support groups there.
Haha. Scotland is expensive too. About £13 for a pack of 20. With my wedding around the corner, I am struggling with an alternative stress relief

So quiting smoking is difficult but essential with ms. I have had a couple of sneaky ones. Now on a tobacco free vape to try and trick my brain. Yummy skittles flavour. I feel like a steam train with the vapour (fake smoke/whatever it's called) #MultipleSclerosis #ms #smokefree

I am very disappointed in the lack of humour over the #Brexit leaving day being on #Halloween. Almost as annoyed as I am at myself for not being able to come up with a pun! Anyone thought of a good one? We need something good to come out of Brexit
The Hydro. We are actually getting married tomorrow. 19/09/19 xx

I'm now Mrs Dethlefs!! Had an amazing wedding in Crieff. So glad I got some wedding converse to change into for the night so I could join in the dancing. Now very tired and ready for our wee trip away together in the Cairngorms as a mini honeymoon. #ms #newlywed

I got the job in Whistler, BC and so has my husband! 10 days to pack up the house and go. Still worried about paying for doctors in Canada. Any information would be wonderful. #ms #MultipleSclerosis #newadventure

I'm going to be a hostess in one of the hotel restaurants. Still using my food tourism degree but without having to balance plates when my hands are numb. I haven't started any DMT yet. Waiting to see what is available in Canada. Xx
Moving to Canada! Fly out on the 21st.
Pumping up the air mattress for our last night in Inverness! 3 days until we fly to Canada #newadventure #MarriedLife
We have landed in Vancouver!!! The adventure begins #newadventure #MarriedLife #mswarrior

Happy to finally get the diagnosis confirmed. I was in the middle of planning my wedding. We got married one month after my confirmed diagnosis and moved the Canada the next month. So...still letting it sink in. #chatms

Happy to finally get the diagnosis confirmed. I was in the middle of planning my wedding. We got married one month after my confirmed diagnosis and moved the Canada the next month. So...still letting it sink in. #chatms

I have just moved to a new job. I do not know if my employer knows I have MS as the application was done by the company I moved to Canada with. So...my biggest struggle is trying to be normal until I have the balls to talk to my boss. Hoping to stay there as long as possible
From moving to Canada, I have all new bank and credit cards. Needing to remember pin numbers is a pain. Still haven't used the credit card as I keep forgetting my PIN
Just had my first pay check in Canadian dollars!! Woo! #traveller #newadventure

Went to aqua aerobics this morning. Was actually a pretty difficult workout but without worrying about falling over. Think I'm going to try to motivate myself to go every Tuesday. #motivation #ms #mswarrior
Officially been given my papers for being laid off until the end of #Covid_19. Enjoyed a bit of sun on the balcony. May as well enjoy the break.
#BlackLivesMatter

So after a lot of thought and a heavy heart, we have decided to leave Canada. It's a beautiful country but Covid. It's time to head home for some family and home comforts. We are heading to my husbands homeland. To Denmark 🇩🇰! #movingforward #newadventure
Oh no! Is this your first time being laid off? I've been back for a month and waiting for my new laid off letter to appear.
Good Morning Warriors. Today it is cool and cloudy! Finally cool enough to feel like I can think. Today will be a packing day, 18 days until we move to Denmark 🇩🇰. Anyone have/had an exciting day?
Ahhhh two more sleeps until the move! I think we are packed but the stress of my husband would make you think otherwise.
It's moving day!!! Fair to say, I've never seen the international departures board so empty. First hop is Frankfurt

We have made it to Flensburg. Staying on the German side of the border in an Airbnb while we get somewhere to live sorted. Already had the first meal of food we have been missing and Flensburger beer 😍. It's 4am, and I can't sleep, jetlag is a bitch.

Me and my husband are both bi. We are both married to the opposite sex but that doesn't mean we aren't attracted to the same sex too. Too many people judge bi people with who they are with. This is an argument I've had with many Christians who believe God has saved them

So yesterday marked the first anniversary of my official diagnosis. Luckily, I was too busy moving countries to ponder on it. Today, I'm so tired and jetlagged that I'm happy to be self isolated. Each day is a new battle and all battle plans are acceptable. #MultipleSclerosis #ms

Sometimes, when moving to new countries new obstacles appear. It dawned on me that I need to learn the Danish alphabet properly before I can get my eyes tested. The way we say 'e' is how they say 'i'.

So today is a rest day! We went to Denmark yesterday and found an apartment and my husband's job interview went amazing. He is a chef, so they want him in for a trail shift but looks like its all coming together. Walked almost 20,000 steps so very quiet day today.
Yeah. My husband's family is needing us closer to home to help during Covid. High risk parents. We will return one day when the world is a bit safer
Reopening my husband's Danish bank account so we can transfer money and pay the deposit on our apartment. 🥳 Not much else planned. What have you got planned?
To Denmark!!! We are signing the contract for our apartment today! So excited it have a place to call home again 😊🥳👫🏠

So I had a meeting with my lecturer today for Danish lessons. She wanted to see what level of education I have in English. I forgot what verbs, adverbs and nouns were. I feel like I never truly knew what there are to be honest 🤦🏻‍♀️😂 #brainfog

Tomorrow is my first day at school in Denmark!! I'm so scared of all the brain fog and forgetfulness. I have two note pads so I can write down everything. Just need to stay calm and hopefully make some new friends.
First day of Danish lessons went well. My brain feels like mince but I think I did alright.

Good Morning you wonderful humans. Had a bad day yesterday, our furniture will not arrive from Scotland until 2021 now so no dining table for Christmas dinner and not sure if the German border will be open to see family. Today I have a to-do list to get through. No more wallowing
Woo. Finally had energy to shave my legs. It had been a while. Mini win for today. #FUMS

We moved back to Europe from Canada. We are in Denmark where all health care is free (including MRIs and such) but I am not working anymore as I'm learning Danish. My husband does have a better pay here though so we can live off his wages. So, maybe better off?
